name: Meet
description: Naira treasury agent for dollar earners. Holds USD₮ in the user's own wallet, buys cNGN just in time within a signed worst rate (Textile or Uniswap on Celo), pays the payee atomically through MeetSettlement, and logs savings against the street rate and the day-1 rate. Code makes every money decision; the LLM only classifies news and writes receipts. Hackathon prototype, not a licensed money service.
